verdict.rationale: First-party CLI docs state that `sv check` reports accessibility hints alongside compiler errors and warnings. A community user corroborates that the Svelte compiler emits built-in compile-time a11y warnings (e.g. a missing alt attribute on ), so no separate audit tool is needed. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the compiler's a11y warning rules and how to configure or suppress them, evidence of in-editor/dev-server surfacing of these warnings, and recent (Svelte 5-era) hands-on corroboration.
